name: floating-input
summary: A text field whose label glides onto the border as an accent halo blooms.
props: Placeholder that floats onto the border.
Set to false to put the label above the field as static text (no notch) and show placeholder inside; filled and underline work too.
Notched outline, rounded filled, or bare underline (filled/underline bars grow from the centre on focus).
44 / 54 / 64pt — font, padding, radius and icons scale too.
Red state, icon + message that slides in, one shake.
Green border + animated check; a string is shown as the message.
Inline text like "₹", "+91", "INR" — fades in when the label floats.
Shows length/maxLength under the field (needs maxLength).
Icons or adornments inside the field.
Animated SVG clear button while there's text.
Focus border, halo and label colour.
Colour behind the field (paints the notch).
Style for the outer wrapper around the field and message line (the one that shakes).

The bordered box: background, border width / colour, radius, height, padding. Wins over the computed style; a borderColor replaces the resting border only (focus, error and success colours still show). A numeric height / borderRadius re-centres the label and resizes the halo.
The typed text — fontSize, fontWeight, color, letterSpacing, fontFamily.

Label in both modes (floating and above). color is the resting colour — focus (accent), error and success still take over; fontSize sets the resting size, it floats at the same ratio and the notch follows its width.
Helper / error / success text. color applies to the helper; error and success keep their tone colour.
Prefix / suffix text (still fades in with the label).
The length/maxLength counter; turns danger at the limit regardless.
behavior: Tapping anywhere on the field focuses the input. With clearable, a × springs in once there is text and empties the field.
The label springs onto the border on focus or when filled, and a soft halo blooms around the field. An error shakes it once; a success check springs in.
The input is labelled with your label and the clear button reads "Clear" plus the label. Helper, error and success messages are polite live regions.
Browser autofill floats the label too, and the field keeps its own background instead of the autofill blue.
